newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices firm, volume doubles.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices firm, volume doubles.

text.p: Prices on Istanbul's gold exchange firmed in line with slightly higher levels in the European markets and volume jumped on free market demand which enlivened on Monday after weekend jewellery and coin sales, dealers said.

Gold closed at 1,108,500 lira per gram and $383.55 an ounce, higher than Friday's 1,104,000 lira and $383.25. Volume totalled 935 kilos of gold, nearly doubling from Friday's 468, but down from last Monday's 1,376 kilos.
Dealers said a weak lira also fuelled gold prices in lira terms. Lira closed at 89,670 against the dollar versus previous 89,260.

"It was typical Monday morning activity with firm free market demand following gold sales there over the weekend. But volume was very low in the second session because traders shied away due to ongoing uncertainty in world markets over the direction of gold prices," said a bank dealer.
Traded volume shrank to 110 kilos in the second session from 825 kilos in the morning. Of the total turnover, 52 percent was in lira terms.
